instruction: Access the History menu and restore the most recently closed TripAdvisor tab.

metadata.explanation: Task directs agent to use History menu to restore TripAdvisor tab. The evaluator verifies all 3 travel website tabs (Lonely Planet, Airbnb, TripAdvisor) are open using is_expected_tabs metric. Alternative approach to keyboard shortcut. No custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_open_tabs_info getter to retrieve all open tab URLs, which is the exact state needed to verify task completion
Metric is_expected_tabs properly compares expected URLs (3 travel sites) against actual open tabs using URL comparison logic
Expected values are semantically correct - all 3 URLs (lonelyplanet.com, airbnb.com, tripadvisor.com) accurately reflect the success state after restoring the TripAdvisor tab
Complete verification coverage - evaluator checks that all 3 tabs are present, which directly verifies the TripAdvisor tab was successfully restored
No state timing issues - open tabs are persistent and immediately accessible via Chrome DevTools Protocol
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts tab list → metric compares URLs → returns 1.0 if all 3 expected tabs present
